BUY-SELL AGREEMENT

This Buy-Sell Agreement is entered into as of April 6, 2026 among Pell Mercantile, Inc. (the "Company") and its shareholders, Noor Haddad and Grace Lindqvist.

1. Intent. The shareholders want the Company to stay in the hands of the people who built it.

2. Good Faith. If a shareholder wants to leave the Company, the shareholders will meet and work out a fair arrangement in good faith.

3. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Minnesota.

PELL MERCANTILE, INC.
